experiment: Part C two-dataset EqMotion aviation adapter smoke
purpose: deterministic runnable-adapter gate only; not a formal baseline result

data.smoke_file_selection: descending file size then ascending filename
data.translation: per-scene valid-aircraft centroid at the last history point

success_criteria: all three data views load a finite batch
all reported smoke metrics are finite
limitations: smoke scenes are a tiny deterministic engineering subset and are not publication evidence
the official implementation instantiates 20 heads; the adapter exposes the first five and leaves the other heads unused
uniform probabilities and fixed candidate zero do not provide a learned top-1 ranking
the 5-second history grid differs from the current MABPT 16-point one-second-history implementation and must be reconciled before a matched formal table
Tartan views were previously opened and cannot be described as fresh confirmation
